caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar with a lid, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The jar is predominantly brown with shades ranging from light tan to reddish-brown, and it has a glossy, uneven surface texture. The vessel has a rounded body, a short, slightly flared neck, and a fitted lid with a small round knob on top. There are two small, curved handles on either side of the neck. The surface of the jar displays areas of greenish and darker brown blotches, especially prominent in two vertical streaks near the upper middle portion, indicating glaze variation. Subtle, random speckling and mottling are visible across the body. The drawing is signed at the bottom left in cursive with the name "Anna Fortuny," and there are small inscriptions with numbers on the lower right. The background remains plain, highlighting the jar as the sole object in the composition.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
